feature_title: Create a FastAPI inventory service using uv and Python 3.14 (requires-python >=3.14): items have name, unique sku, quantity >= 0 and price; endpoints create an item, list items with limit/offset pagination and a name filter, get an item by sku, and adjust stock with POST /items/{sku}/adjust taking a delta that may not drive quantity below zero (409); pytest tests using FastAPI's TestClient, verified by uv run pytest -q.
warnings: list_items takes `limit`/`offset` as plain ints with no lower bound (e.g. Field(ge=0)) or upper bound on limit. A negative offset silently falls back to Python's tail-slicing semantics (e.g. offset=-1 returns items from the end) instead of a 422, and there is no cap on limit to bound response size.

test_pyproject_requires_python_3_14 checks pyproject.toml packaging metadata; it doesn't exercise item behavior like every other test in this file, mixing an unrelated concern into a file otherwise scoped to the /items API.
